programs.title: Charmed to Death
programs.desc: When a student meets an esteemed psychologist, she's certain she's found her soul mate; when he suddenly disappears, she discovers he has been living a bizarre double life in Detroit's most notorious neighborhood.

programs.title: Targeted for Murder
programs.desc: When the Amish circle their wagons around a brutal murder amongst their own, investigators must dig deep to unearth the chilling secrets behind the simple facade of Amish country.

programs.title: Finally Caught
programs.desc: On Halloween night, Erik Poltorak opens his door, unaware of the danger awaiting him; what happens next leaves detectives struggling to unravel a carefully laid plan.

programs.title: Bif Naked
programs.desc: Bif Naked rips the lid off the life of one of Canada's most fearless and iconic artists. With unprecedented access and Bif's own unapologetic voice, this is a ride from gritty punk clubs to platinum albums, through cancer wards, courtrooms, and backstage chaos, proving that survival is the most punk rock thing of all.

programs.title: This Time Next Year
programs.desc: Minnie and Quinn are born on the same day, one minute apart. Their lives may begin together, but their worlds couldn't be more different. Years later they find themselves together again. Maybe it's time to take a chance on love.

programs.title: Don't Open the Door
programs.desc: In a slow real estate market, IBM executive Diane Holik is thrilled when a stranger knocks on her door offering to buy her Austin home for cash.
